title: The Schism of Waking and Dream
description: The catastrophic failure of containment leads to a new, unstable hybrid reality. Vast regions are now permanently blended zones called 'Liminal Reaches,' where dream logic and physical law compete. Factions splinter: Purists seek to violently re-segregate the worlds, while Syncretists believe this merger is evolution and seek to master it. Lucids become either prophets or pariahs.
premise: The catastrophic failure of containment leads to a new, unstable hybrid reality. Vast regions are now permanently blended zones called 'Liminal Reaches,' where dream logic and physical law compete. narrative_direction: From reaction to ideological schism. The world is no longer trying to go back, but is now divided on how to move forward. New world rules emerge in the Liminal Reaches.
unresolved_mysteries: Do the Nightmares have their own intelligence and goals, or are they merely chaotic reflections?
What exists in the deep Dreaming beyond the Veil's former boundary? Is there a 'source' to Oneiros?
plot_hooks: A Syncretist faction successfully engineers a stable, thriving city-state within a Liminal Reach, proving controlled coexistence is possible.
Purists enact a 'Great Severing' ritual, which doesn't restore the Veil but instead crystallizes entire regions into purely Waking or purely Dreaming states, creating impassable metaphysical borders.
central_conflict: A philosophical and literal war over the future state of reality: forced separation versus guided synthesis.
